detail.title: Ceramic tile mould convenient to spread and paste
detail.abstract: The utility model provides a tile mould convenient for paving and pasting, which comprises a shell, a small-sized air suction pump and a shunt pipe, wherein the upper side surface of the shell is provided with a handle, the outer surface of the handle is provided with an anti-abrasion sleeve, the upper side surface of the shell is provided with a fixing box, the fixing boxes are respectively arranged at the front side and the rear side of the handle, the left side surface and the right side surface inside the fixing box are respectively provided with a fixing block, the inside of the fixing box is provided with a horizontal tester, the left side surface and the right side surface of the horizontal tester are both provided with a connecting block, and the connecting blocks are connected with the fixing blocks through connecting screws, the small-sized air suction pump is arranged inside the shell, the tile mould convenient for paving and pasting is provided with a horizontal tester, when the paving and pasting mould is used for paving and pasting tiles, the staff can conveniently adjust the horizontal condition of placing of ceramic tile, causes the ceramic tile to spread the effect better.
assignees: 佛山市密斯特工业有限公司
